# Start here

This is your personal memory vault. Open this folder as a vault in Obsidian, or edit notes in Aurora.

- [[10 Profile/About me|About me]] — preferences and context you want remembered

Use **Remember** for a fact, **New note** for knowledge, and **Today** for a daily note. Link notes with `[[note name]]`. Chat journals are history, not confirmed facts. Proposed memories are excluded from recall until you approve them.

Pinned notes are included in every conversation. Avoid putting passwords or tokens in your memory.
